text.zh: 制作汇报前明确主题、受众及知识水平、沟通或决策目的、时长和已有素材。已有信息不重复询问；缺失且会改变结果的信息一次集中确认。提炼核心信息、期望行动和关键证据，不能凭空假定主题或编造素材。需要采用默认条件时先说明条件及其依据。
text.en: Before making a report, clarify the topic, the audience and their knowledge level, the communication or decision purpose, the duration and the existing material. Do not ask again for information you already have; confirm missing information that would change the result in one batch. Distil the core message, the expected action and the key evidence; never assume a topic out of thin air or invent material. When default conditions have to be used, state the conditions and their basis first.

zh: 仅在制作或检查汇报时适用
en: Only when producing or reviewing reports

purpose.zh: 明确汇报情境并基于真实素材提炼，避免凭空假定主题或编造素材
purpose.en: Clarify the context and distil from real material, avoiding an assumed topic or invented material

exclude.zh: 已经掌握的信息（不重复询问）
exclude.en: Information already available (do not ask again)
